One day you'll put on those scrubs, hear someone call you "nurse," and realize every late night, every tear, and every challenge was worth it.  Your dream is still possible. One test does not define you.One bad semester does not define you.One setback does not erase the reason you started. The patients who will someday need your compassion, your strength, and your care don't know your GPA. They won't remember how many times you doubted yourself. They'll remember how you made them feel. Keep studying.Keep showing up.Keep believing. One day you'll put on those scrubs, hear someone call you "nurse," and realize every late night, every tear, and every challenge was worth it. Your dream is still possible. Signed,A nurse who once wondered if she could do it too ❤️ #nurselife #nursingschool  #nursingstudent #nursestudent
